```yaml
name: Nightly Release with Commitizen

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'  # Run daily at 2 AM UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7

      - name: Set up Python
        run: uv python install 3.11

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv sync --all-extras

      - name: Run pre-commit hooks
        run: uv run pre-commit run --all-files

      - name: Check for release commits
        id: check_release
        run: |
          # Check if there are any bump commits in the last 2 commits
          LAST_TWO_COMMITS=$(git log --oneline -n 2)
          if echo "$LAST_TWO_COMMITS" | grep -q "bump:"; then
            echo "release_needed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "release_needed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Bump version and generate changelog
        if: steps.check_release.outputs.release_needed == 'true'
        run: |
          # Run commitizen bump with changelog generation
          uv run cz bump --changelog --yes
          
          # Commit the changes
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add .
          git commit -m "chore: update changelog and version" || echo "No changes to commit"

      - name: Push changes
        if: steps.check_release.outputs.release_needed == 'true'
        uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@v5
        with:
          commit_message: "chore: update changelog and version"
          commit_options: "--signoff"
          branch: main
          push_options: "--force-with-lease"

      - name: Create release
        if: steps.check_release.outputs.release_needed == 'true'
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ steps.version.outputs.new_version }}
          name: Release ${{ steps.version.outputs.new_version }}
          body: |
            Automated release generated from nightly workflow.
            
            Changes:
            ${{ steps.changelog.outputs.changelog }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
